source.section: PDF page 13, Line 14 Social Security Benefits; Form N-11 line 14; Form N-11 lines 7-12, 19-20 and 23-27 (pages 2-3); PDF page 11 (Line 7), PDF page 20 (Line 23 standard deduction table, Line 25 exemptions), PDF page 9 (Lines 6a, 6b, 'age 65 or over as of January 1, 2026'), PDF page 20 (Line 27 Tax Table), PDF page 50 (2025 Tax Rate Schedules)

worked: Single, 67: Railroad Retirement Board annuity 24,000 (all of it in federal AGI), interest 30,000. The projection exempts railroad retirement in full (hi_railroad_retirement, from the line 14 rule: 'Hawaii does not tax Social Security or first tier Railroad Retirement Act benefits'). The booklet names only first tier benefits; this case follows the projection and subtracts the whole 24,000 (accepted approximation for any Tier 2 part). Age-65 exemption claimed. Line 7 federal AGI = railroad retirement annuity 24,000.00 + interest 30,000.00 = 54,000.00. Federal taxable income = 54,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 age-65 addition = 36,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Line 11 total additions = 0.00; line 12 = 54,000.00 + 0.00 = 54,000.00. Line 14 railroad retirement benefits (projection: exempt in full) 24,000.00. Line 19 total subtractions = 24,000.00; line 20 Hawaii AGI = 54,000.00 - 24,000.00 = 30,000.00. Line 23 standard deduction (single, PDF page 20 table) 4,400.00; line 24 = 30,000.00 - 4,400.00 = 25,600.00. Line 6e exemptions: 1 regular + 1 age 65 or over = 2; line 25 = 2 x 1,144.00 = 2,288.00. Line 26 taxable income = 25,600.00 - 2,288.00 = 23,312.00. Line 27 tax, Schedule I (PDF page 50) as bands on 23,312.00: 9,600.00 x 1.4% = 134.40; 4,800.00 x 3.2% = 153.60; 4,800.00 x 5.5% = 264.00; 4,112.00 x 6.4% = 263.168; sum = 815.168, to the cent 815.17; tax = 815.17 (Form N-11 line 27 uses the Tax Table below 100,000 of taxable income (PDF page 20, Line 27): the table row 23,300 to 23,350 gives 816; this case uses the bands as numbers). No credits modelled (refundable food/excise and renters credits, lines 28-29, not claimed): state income tax = 815.17.
accepted_approximations: Railroad retirement is exempt in full; the booklet names only first tier Railroad Retirement Act benefits, and Tier 2 is not stated.
